description: Structured eval definitions for the CodeCommit Repository Deployer. Five-case proven set exercising the READY_TO_DEPLOY / PREREQUISITES_MISSING classification across CodeCommit repository topologies (standard repo with KMS + approval rules, cross-account resource policy + KMS key policy, branch protection + notification + PR template + trigger, git-remote-codecommit IAM auth, missing KMS key policy cross-account grant, missing notification SNS topic policy). Each eval maps to a prompt file and a baseline (no-skill) file for with-skill-vs-baseline comparison.

eval_cases.name: Standard CodeCommit repository with KMS encryption and approval rule template
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — standard repo with customer-managed KMS key (policy grants CodeCommit), approval rule template (2 reviewers) associated, branch protection on main
eval_cases.prompt: Create a CodeCommit repository named my-app-repo in us-east-1, account 123456789012. Default branch main. Description "Microservice repository for my-app". KMS encryption with customer-managed key arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/abcd-1234. Approval rule template require-two-reviewers (2 approvals from pool alice, bob). Branch protection on main (deny direct push). Tags: Environment=production, Team=platform.
eval_cases.expected_output:
CODECOMMIT_REPO: my-app-repo (arn:aws:codecommit:us-east-1:123456789012:my-app-repo)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Repository name: my-app-repo
  [✓] Default branch: main (created at first push)
  [✓] KMS encryption: customer-managed key abcd-1234 (policy grants codecommit.amazonaws.com)
  [✓] Approval rule template: require-two-reviewers (2 approvals)
  [✓] Branch protection: IAM denies direct push to main
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws codecommit get-repository --repository-name my-app-repo --region us-east-1
  aws kms describe-key --key-id abcd-1234 --region us-east-1

eval_cases.name: Cross-account CodeCommit access via resource policy and KMS key policy
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — cross-account access: repository resource policy grants GitPull/GitPush, KMS key policy also grants cross-account principal (both required)
eval_cases.prompt: Configure cross-account access for CodeCommit repository my-app-repo in us-east-1, account 123456789012, to grant access to account 999999999999. The repository is encrypted with customer-managed KMS key arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/abcd-1234. Grant codecommit:GitPull and codecommit:GitPush to the cross-account principal.
eval_cases.expected_output:
CODECOMMIT_REPO: my-app-repo (arn:aws:codecommit:us-east-1:123456789012:my-app-repo)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Cross-account access: resource policy grants 999999999999
  [✓] KMS key policy cross-account: granted to 999999999999

eval_cases.name: Branch protection, notification rules, PR template, and trigger
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — branch protection (IAM deny push to main), notification rule to SNS (topic policy grants CodeStar), PR template, Lambda trigger (target policy grants CodeCommit)
eval_cases.prompt: Configure my-app-repo in us-east-1, account 123456789012, with branch protection on main (deny direct GitPush, force PR workflow), notification rule for pull-request-created and pull-request-merged events to SNS topic arn:aws:sns:us-east-1:123456789012:codecommit-notifications, pull request template at .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md, and a repository trigger invoking Lambda function arn:aws:lambda:us-east-1:123456789012:function:trigger-handler on all events.
eval_cases.expected_output:
CODECOMMIT_REPO: my-app-repo
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Branch protection: IAM policy denies direct push to main
  [✓] Notification rule: PR events → SNS (topic policy grants codestar-notifications.amazonaws.com)
  [✓] Pull request template: .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md
  [✓] Repository trigger: trigger-handler (Lambda policy grants codecommit.amazonaws.com)

eval_cases.name: CodeCommit repository with git-remote-codecommit (GRC) IAM auth
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — GRC for developer auth (SSO/federated), IAM git credentials for CI pipeline, session-token based auth selection
eval_cases.prompt: Create a CodeCommit repository named platform-tools in us-east-1, account 123456789012. Developers authenticate via SSO and should use git-remote-codecommit (GRC). The CI pipeline uses a dedicated IAM user ci-codecommit-user with static git credentials. Default branch main. Tags: Environment=production.
eval_cases.expected_output:
CODECOMMIT_REPO: platform-tools
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Auth method: git-remote-codecommit (GRC) for developers, IAM git credentials for CI

eval_cases.name: Cross-account CodeCommit access with missing KMS key policy (prerequisite failure)
eval_cases.branch: PREREQUISITES_MISSING — cross-account access requested but KMS key policy does not grant the cross-account principal
eval_cases.prompt: Configure cross-account access for CodeCommit repository shared-repo in us-east-1, account 123456789012, to grant access to account 888888888888. The repository is encrypted with customer-managed KMS key arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/efgh-5678. The KMS key policy currently only grants the owning account root and does NOT include the cross-account principal.
eval_cases.expected_output:
CODECOMMIT_REPO: shared-repo
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✗] KMS key policy cross-account: NOT granted to 888888888888 — key policy must grant the cross-account principal kms:Decrypt, kms:Encrypt, kms:GenerateDataKey*
